jurisdictions.name: Portsmouth
notes: The Inspection Department lists pools, above and below ground, among new structures that need a building permit.
Applications need plans or sketches of the scope of work and a site plan showing setbacks.
The city says most residential projects do not need stamped structural plans, and the code official decides when engineered plans are required.
Electric, plumbing and mechanical permits are submitted online; a project in a Historic District that changes the exterior needs a separate Historic District Commission application.

jurisdictions.name: Manchester
jurisdictions.office: City of Manchester Planning and Community Development Department, Building
notes: Effective July 1, 2024, the department enforces the 2021 International Residential Code and 2021 International Swimming Pool and Spa Code, with state and local amendments.
It also lists the 2018 International Energy Conservation Code and the 2020 National Electrical Code.
Electrical and plumbing permit applications can be filled out online but must be printed, signed and mailed in with fees.
The city's Health Department has separate Pool and Spa Permits pages under Recreational Water Quality.

jurisdictions.name: Concord
jurisdictions.office: City of Concord Permits & Fees (Code Administration)
notes: The city lists Building, Fire Prevention, Mechanical, Plumbing, Electrical, Demolition and Change of Occupancy permits.
The online Permit Portal handles applications, saved templates, inspection viewing and invoice payment.
